scope: GPU scene BVH traversal with 6-primitive ray intersection and per-ray semantic hits; mesh hit semantics deferred to S3; default capture elimination flags only; no node-layout assertions

authoring.purpose: one-off offline capture of device-side f32 poses plus reference hits (not part of product build/test/gate chain)
authoring.determinism: two full captures bitwise identical; second pass 0.216 s; capture wall time 15.9 s including first NVRTC module compiles

gpu_window.note: no other full-load GPU task running; memory returned to desktop baseline after the run

launcher_wiring.compile_recipe: NVRTC, fmad=true, fast_math=false, --std=c++17, compute_70, PTX gate allows only f32
launcher_wiring.launch: existing generic four-buffer launch (i32 metadata, f32 parameters, f32 rays, f32 output, 4 u32 dims, 256 threads); runtime files unchanged
launcher_wiring.not_used: src/runtime/launcher is the unified launcher artifact/cache layer (M1/M2); W15 include/warp-headers/bvh.h consumes Warp's internal BVH layout and is not reused by the custom node layout
launcher_wiring.device_fma: real fma.rn.f32 via NVRTC fmad=true; the S2a host f64 emulation is not used on the device path

fixture.content: 384 ray origins/directions (f32 bits), initial and moved cases with device-side f32 geom poses and reference dist/geomid/normal bits, source hashes, environment

reference_input_correction.finding: S0b/S2 reference hits come from MJWarp device-side f32 geom poses; the S2 npz geom_xpos is the CPU pose
reference_input_correction.symptom: feeding CPU poses to the product kernel shifted an initial cylinder hit by 124 ULP on ray 92 (4 ULP budget)
reference_input_correction.fix: new authoring capture records the exact device-side f32 pose bits plus the reference hits and cross-checks them against the committed S0b/S2 npz references (7/7 equal)
reference_input_correction.note: S2a host AABB acceptance is unchanged: it is a CPU-pose-input layer check; S2b builds its BVH from the recorded device poses

results.normal_angle_metric: f64 atan2(|cross|, dot) between unit normals; a naive f32 dot+acos inflates ~1e-7 rad angles to ~1e-3 rad and is not used

refit.conclusion: geomid change set matches the reference on every non-mesh ray; distance for those rays is 0 ULP

rejection_surface: empty scene at the S2a build layer
results.node_layout_assertions: none; tests assert only semantic hits and group separation

tests.gpu_result: 3 passed / 0 failed (0.53 s test body, 5.17 s wall including cargo NVRTC build)

acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_1_ray_semantics: pass for primitive hits and misses: 383 initial + 382 moved rays, geomid exact, max distance ULP 0, max normal angle 4.6e-8 rad <= 1e-4
acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_2_aabb_bit_equal: S2a verified (56/56, max ULP 0); not re-asserted here
acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_3_refit_change: geomid change set matches on compared rays; ray 92 becomes a mesh hit and is deferred to S3
acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_4_world_groups: pass: 2 worlds x 384 rays, 0 cross-world candidates, world1 ids offset by 100 with identical distance bits
acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_5_rejections: pass: empty rays / world out of range / geometry length mismatch / hfield; empty scene covered at the S2a build layer
acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_6_no_layout_assertions: pass: only semantic hit and grouping results are asserted

not_claimed: mesh triangle intersection or mesh hit distance/normals (S3); mesh rays are excluded from the pass criteria
all 384 rays for every case: the compared set is 383 initial and 382 moved (mesh hits excluded)
parameterized bodyexclude / geomgroup / flg_static / invisible-material elimination
full renderer or product rendering acceptance
unmet: initial ray 91 (mesh hit) and moved rays 91/92 are deferred to S3; the 6th geomid change ray 92 is mesh-related and not compared
single frozen scene-a fixture and 384 fixed rays; no fuzz or random ray sets
rotated plane hit path has no independent GPU reference (scene-a floor is static identity)
kernel supports only the default elimination flags used by the frozen capture
fixed 128-entry traversal stack; deeper BVHs are rejected before packing
S2b rebuilds AABBs from the reference device poses; those may differ by <=1 ULP from the S2a initial CPU-pose AABBs (S2a acceptance semantics unchanged)
hash_basis: artifact sha256/bytes/lines are LF-normalized content (committed git blob semantics), not the Windows working-tree CRLF forms
